<p>In the current four-game international window, El Tri, under new coach Rafael Marquez, is winless through three games.</p>
<p>“It’s a process,” Marquez said Saturday <a href="https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401905202">after Mexico lost to the United States, 3-0</a>. “I think there are positives to take away, but obviously, we need to be self-critical, understand what happened, and bounce back as quickly as possible because we have another match coming up.”</p>
<p>The final match of the window brings Mexico “home” to Los Angeles and the Coliseum, to face Chile. Mexico has always drawn well in L.A. <p>Mexico played its 2026 World Cup send-off match at the Rose Bowl on May 30, with 78,479 in attendance.</p>
<p>Mexico’s tour across the U.S. began with 1-1 draws against Colombia in Baltimore (Sept. 26) and Peru in New Jersey (Sept. 29), which all led to Saturday’s 3-0 drubbing at the hands of the Americans.</p>
<p>“It’s simple. In football, you win, draw and lose, you have to be prepared for that,” Márquez said Saturday. “The most important thing is knowing how to bounce back, engaging in self-criticism to understand what we did right and what we did wrong, and then continuing to work.”</p>
<p>According to ESPN, Marquez is the first Mexico coach to fail to record a win in his first three games since Manuel Lapuente in 1997. Marquez replaced Javier Aguirre <a href="https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49283428/mexico-proud-hurt-exiting-world-cup-england">after Mexico’s Round of 16 exit at the World Cup this summer</a>. He was a five-time World Cup participant with El Tri and began his coaching career at Barcelona Atletic, the reserve team of FC Barcelona.</p>				<div class="dfp-ad dfp-outstream_video" id="div-gpt-ad-outstream_video">

<p>Chile finished last in South American World Cup qualifying and has dropped its first two exhibition matches of the window, 1-0 against Canada (Sept. 26) and 4-2 against the U.S. (Sept. 29).</p>
<h4>MEMO OCHOA TO BE HONORED</h4>
<p>During pregame festivities, legendary Mexico goalkeeper Memo Ochoa will be honored. Ochoa retired from soccer after the team was eliminated from the World Cup. He made 154 appearances for the Mexican national team and is the first and only goalkeeper to appear in six World Cup tournaments.</p>
<p>Ochoa is the all-time MexTour leader among goalkeepers with 38 appearances since the tour first began in 2003. He earned 154 caps for Mexico all-time and became the first goalkeeper to appear in a record six World Cups.</p>
<p>The “Thank You, Memo!” pregame ceremony will feature fan appreciation videos and the lighting of the stadium’s iconic Olympic cauldron.</p>				<div class="dfp-ad dfp-cube_article" id="div-gpt-ad-cube_article">

			var email = getAuthEmail();
			if (email) {
				resolve(email);
				return;
			}
			var started = Date.now();
			var poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				var nextEmail = getAuthEmail();
				if (nextEmail) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve(nextEmail);
				} else if (Date.now() - started > readyTimeoutMs) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve('');
				}
			}, 50);
		});
	}

	function urlWithoutWallOverride() {
		var url = new URL(window.location.href);
		if (!url.searchParams.has('wall_override')) {
			return '';
		}
		url.searchParams.delete('wall_override');
		return url.pathname + url.search + url.hash;
	}

	function dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar() {
		var cleanPath = urlWithoutWallOverride();
		if (!cleanPath) {
			return false;
		}
		window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.origin + cleanPath);
		console.info(logPrefix, 'removed wall_override from the URL before embed login reload');
		return true;
	}

	(function patchLocationReload() {
		try {
			var originalReload = window.location.reload.bind(window.location);
			window.location.reload = function () {
				if (sessionStorage.getItem(pendingFlag) === '1') {
					var cleanPath = urlWithoutWallOverride();
					if (cleanPath) {
						console.info(logPrefix, 'embed login reload: dropping wall_override');
						window.location.replace(window.location.origin + cleanPath);
						return;
					}
				}
				return originalReload();
			};
		} catch (e) {}
	})();

	var finishingSocialLogin = false;

	function finishRegwallSocialLogin() {
		if (finishingSocialLogin) {
			return;
		}
		finishingSocialLogin = true;
		hideSocialLogin();

		waitForAuthEmail().then(function () {
			if (sessionStorage.getItem(newsletterDoneFlag) === '1') {
				return false;
			}
			return subscribeRegwallNewsletter().then(function (ok) {
				sessionStorage.setItem(newsletterDoneFlag, '1');
				console.info(logPrefix, 'newsletter subscribe', ok ? 'succeeded' : 'skipped or failed');
				return ok;
			});
		}).catch(function (err) {
			console.error(logPrefix, 'newsletter subscribe error', err);
		}).then(function () {
			if (!isEntitledSubscriber()) {
				grantRegwallAccessCookies();
			}
			return waitForNativeSession();
		}).then(function (hasSession) {
			if (!hasSession) {
				console.warn(logPrefix, 'embed login did not persist __MNG_Session');
			}
			dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar();
			sessionStorage.removeItem(pendingFlag);
			sessionStorage.removeItem(reloadedFlag);
			sessionStorage.removeItem(newsletterDoneFlag);
			finishingSocialLogin = false;
		});
	}

	function onAuthenticated() {
		hideSocialLogin();
		if (sessionStorage.getItem(pendingFlag) === '1') {
			dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar();
			finishRegwallSocialLogin();
		}
	}

				settled = true;
				cleanup();

			function fail(message) {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				reject(new Error(message));

					return;

				button.click();
				button.__mngSocialForward = false;

			}
			return waitForEmbedReady().then(function () {
